item.title: Nasdaq falls 4.5% in worst week since June as AI stocks slide
item.description: The Nasdaq Composite fell 4.5% this week, its worst week since late June. The CNN Fear & Greed index dropped to 18 from 46 a week earlier. U.S. bank stocks rose after earnings.

item.title: Fed's Waller says another rate cut is on the table
item.description: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that a rate cut in December remains possible if inflation keeps easing. He spoke at an event in New York.
